ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the autism program, and explore ways to prevent future fraud.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can Medicaid programs be improved to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and waste in Medicaid programs, which could lead to improved oversight and accountability.
